title: DreamNest AI: Personalised Bedtime Stories for Kids
excerpt: A new bedtime story every night, starring your child by name, with a gentle lesson and calm narration.
description: DreamNest AI writes a new bedtime story every night starring your child, with a gentle lesson and soothing narration. Here's how it works and who it's for.
body:
DreamNest AI writes a brand-new bedtime story every night, starring your child by name. Each story is calm, carries a gentle lesson, and can be read aloud by a soothing narrator, so bedtime becomes something to look forward to.

## How it works

- Add your child: their name, age and favourite things, like dinosaurs, space or unicorns
- Choose tonight's feeling: brave, calm, curious or sleepy
- Read together, or let the narrator take over as eyes get heavy

## What makes it different

- **Every story is new.** Stories are created around your child's details and tonight's feeling, so they never repeat.
- **A gentle lesson every night.** Kindness, courage and patience, taught warmly and never preachy.
- **Soothing narration.** A calm, sleep-friendly voice reads each story aloud.
- **A story library.** Save favourites and read them again any night, even offline.

## Who it's for

DreamNest works best for children aged about 2 to 10, and for parents who want a calm, screen-light routine that still feels special.

## Is it safe?

Stories are generated with child-safe guidelines, kept age-appropriate and always end on a calm note. You can delete your account and data at any time.

## What you need

Creating a new story needs an internet connection. Stories you've saved can be read offline.

DreamNest AI is free to try on Google Play, with a story library and free stories included. Visit the app page below to see how it looks.
